---
title: "Outside the workshop"
---
The session stops before the class chart and before Task 5, in which you choose one specification and fix it in a preregistration block before you run it. Both run in the [webR workspace](../../lab.qmd#task-5-preregistration) and in the [IDE workspace]({{< var cases.housing.workspace-zip >}}), which needs R and an IDE, installed by following the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html).

The modules of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) each stand on their own.

- [Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd)
- [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd)
- [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd), with the [graph cell of the webR workspace](../../lab.qmd#task-2-estimand-and-graph), which lets you try the causal graph of the session
- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd)
- [Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html)
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html)

The final report of the replication in the SCORE replicability study is at [osf.io/2ug8x](https://osf.io/2ug8x/), and its de-identified data, do-file and dictionary are at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/).
